summary: This document outlines an agenda and notes from a meeting focused on various aspects of work life, particularly within the IT sector. Key discussion points included experiences in different job roles, the evolution of IT recruitment, the distinct characteristics of different industries (retail, creative, IT), and the nuances of company cultures both in Finland and internationally. The notes also covered the impact of open-plan offices, cultural differences in workplace hierarchies (e.g., India/Asia vs. Finland), and practical advice regarding skill development (e.g., Microsoft environment) and internship applications at institutions like Aalto University.
agenda_questions: Experiences of both individuals in various job roles.
Work-life practices and 'rules of the game'.
How IT recruitment has changed from the beginning of career to the present; whether any requirements or emphases have disappeared or emerged.
Differences between work life in retail, video/creative, and IT sectors; what to expect and prepare for; what has been the biggest difference.
Reasons for successfully obtaining jobs in the past and in the most recent role.
Diversity of companies and company cultures in Finland and internationally.
How Finnish company culture in IT differs from international environments; whether different operating methods should be expected.
